result.instructions: Tools for Cronofy, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cronofy data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run cronofy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cronofy_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cronofy_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. cronofy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cronofy_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the authenticated Cronofy account's details (id, email, name, default tzid, locale). API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: cronofy_get_userinfo
tools.title: Get userinfo
tools.description: Get the OpenID-style profile of the authenticated user (sub, email, Cronofy profile info). API: GET /v1/userinfo.

tools.name: cronofy_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List all calendars the authenticated account can see (id, name, profile, readonly, primary). API: GET /v1/calendars.

tools.name: cronofy_list_profiles
tools.title: List profiles
tools.description: List the connected calendar accounts/profiles (e.g. Google, Office 365) linked to this Cronofy account. API: GET /v1/profiles.

tools.name: cronofy_read_events
tools.title: Read events
tools.description: Read events across the account's calendars over a time window. Returns { pages, events }. API: GET /v1/events.

tzid.description: REQUIRED time zone id for the response, e.g. "Etc/UTC" or "America/New_York".

from.description: Start of the window — date (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 datetime.

to.description: End of the window — date (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 datetime.

calendar_ids.description: Restrict to these calendar ids (sent as repeated calendar_ids[] params).

include_managed.description: Include events created via the Cronofy API. Default false.

last_modified.description: Only events modified since this ISO 8601 datetime.

only_managed.description: Return only events created via the Cronofy API. Default false.

tools.name: cronofy_get_free_busy
tools.title: Get free/busy
tools.description: Read free/busy information across the account's calendars over a time window. Returns { pages, free_busy }. API: GET /v1/free_busy.

tzid.description: REQUIRED time zone id for the response, e.g. "Etc/UTC".

from.description: Start of the window — date (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 datetime.

to.description: End of the window — date (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 datetime.

calendar_ids.description: Restrict to these calendar ids (sent as repeated calendar_ids[] params).

include_managed.description: Include events created via the Cronofy API. Default false.

tools.name: cronofy_upsert_event
tools.title: Create or update event
tools.description: Creates or updates an event on a REAL connected calendar (upsert by event_id). This writes to the user's actual calendar. API: POST /v1/calendars/{calendar_id}/events.

event_id.description: YOUR unique id for the event. Re-using it updates the same event.

start.description: Event start — ISO 8601 datetime or a date (yyyy-mm-dd) string.

end.description: Event end — ISO 8601 datetime or a date (yyyy-mm-dd) string.

tzid.description: Time zone id for the start/end, e.g. "America/New_York".

tools.name: cronofy_delete_event
tools.title: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes an event (by your event_id) from a real connected calendar. Destructive. API: DELETE /v1/calendars/{calendar_id}/events.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id the event lives on.

event_id.description: YOUR event_id for the event to delete (sent in the JSON body).
